title: Section formulas for the point cyclotomic action
statement: For a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and let $U=(s,\operatorname{id})$ be the final object of its pro-etale site. Use geometric Frobenius $g$, the restriction map, and the canonical comma arrow [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. Define the section arrow $j:U\to g^*U$ as the comma arrow followed by $g^*$ of restriction. For each root sheaf [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], its section action is its inverse-image adjunction unit, followed by the root comparison [def-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image], followed by restriction along $j$. Define the root-limit action by the rootSection comparison of [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists] followed by restriction along $j$. For integral or finite coefficients and each signed line $B(m)$ [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], define the section action by the corresponding module inverse-image unit, the specified signedLineMaps or finiteSignedLineMaps comparison [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists], then restriction along $j$. Scalar multiplication uses the constant-section map, with its quotient-compatible completion for integral coefficients. Positive generators are the recorded pure root tensors, evaluation uses the identity slice of the internal Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and the successor tensor is the defining sheaf-tensor pure-section map [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. The constant coefficient action is the same unit/comparison/restriction composite. These are the existing section formulas of the parent cyclotomic-action statement, extracted unchanged.
